topics.topic: Les Verbes du Premier Groupe (-er verbs): Parler, habiter, aimer
learningObjectives: Identify regular -er ending verbs in present indicative tense
Conjugate verbs with standard endings (-e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent)
Formulate sentences expressing personal preferences, hobbies, and sports

topics.topic: Exprimer l'Heure et les Activités Quotidiennes: What time is it?
learningObjectives: Ask and tell time in French (Quelle heure est-il ? Il est ... heures)
Use expressions of time (et quart, et demie, moins le quart)
Relate daily routines to specific hours of the day

topics.topic: Les Verbes Pronominaux: Se lever, se laver, se brosser les dents
learningObjectives: Understand reflexive pronouns (me, te, se, nous, vous, se)
Conjugate reflexive verbs describing personal morning routines
Draft a sequential paragraph recounting daily activities from dawn to dusk

topics.topic: Les Aliments et les Repas: Le petit-déjeuner, le déjeuner, le dîner
learningObjectives: Identify foods, fruits, and beverages commonly consumed in West Africa
Use partitive articles (du, de la, de l', des) to express indefinite quantities
Order meals and drinks politely in a restaurant dialogue (Je voudrais...)

topics.topic: Le Marché et les Achats: Asking prices and quantities (Combien coûte...?)
learningObjectives: Inquire about prices using Combien coûte... and Ça fait combien ?
Handle French currency terms and count higher numerals up to 500
Role-play buying vegetables, fish, and fruits in an open-air French market

topics.topic: Demander et Indiquer le Chemin: Orientations and prepositions of place
learningObjectives: Inquire about directions (Où se trouve la poste ? Pour aller à la gare ?)
Give clear navigation instructions (Tournez à droite, allez tout droit)
Use place prepositions (près de, loin de, devant, derrière, en face de)

topics.topic: Contrôle Continu et Évaluation Orale de Mi-Semestre
learningObjectives: Evaluate pupil mastery of regular verbs, time-telling, and food vocabulary
Test listening comprehension using recorded French dialogic scenarios
Target individual speech articulation difficulties

topics.topic: Les Vêtements et les Tissus: Dressing and fashionable styles
learningObjectives: Name common articles of clothing, footwear, and accessories
Use the verb porter to describe outfits worn for weather and ceremonies
Harmonize adjective agreement for styles, fabrics, and patterns

topics.topic: Le Corps Humain et la Santé: Chez le médecin (J'ai mal à...)
learningObjectives: Identify major external body parts (la tête, les yeux, le ventre, le bras)
Express bodily discomfort using the idiom Avoir mal à + article
Simulate a medical consultation with a French-speaking doctor

topics.topic: Le Verbe "Aller" et le Futur Proche: Going places and upcoming plans
learningObjectives: Conjugate the irregular verb aller in present tense
Use contractions with à (au, à la, à l', aux) when going to places
Formulate future plans using the near future structure (Aller + infinitif)

topics.topic: Les Métiers et les Professions: Future career aspirations
learningObjectives: Name traditional and modern professions in French (médecin, avocat, ingénieur)
Formulate feminine forms of professions (-eur/-euse, -ien/-ienne)
Compose a short essay titled "Mon métier préféré pour l'avenir"

topics.topic: Révision Trimestrielle et Pratique des Dialogues Communicatifs
learningObjectives: Synthesize conversational situations: directions, markets, health, and routines
Review syntax of reflexive verbs and the near future tense
Practice oral fluency through paired conversational simulations

topics.topic: Examen de Fin de Trimestre et Enregistrement des Notes
learningObjectives: Assess reading comprehension, functional grammar, and creative writing
Evaluate oral communication skills in interactive interview stations
Collate terminal scores for official school report cards
